sources.entry: Open eClass - Open eClass is an advanced e-learning solution that can enhance the teaching and learning process. (Demo, Source Code) GPL-2.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Open eClass is a PHP-based course management system for asynchronous e-learning, developed by the Greek Academic Network (GUnet) and distributed under GPL-2.0.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes Open eClass (formerly GUnet eClass) as a complete Course Management System used to store and present educational materials. It is positioned for asynchronous e-learning, meaning teaching and learning that does not require students and teachers to be online at the same time. The platform is in development toward version 4.5. Installation requires a web server with PHP 8.2 or newer and a MySQL or MariaDB database server. The README points to external manuals and installation instructions but does not list specific features in the text provided. It has been distributed since March 2003.
use_cases: run an online course management system
asynchronous e-learning for a university or school
organize and present course content digitally
how_to_run: Set up a web server with PHP >= 8.2
Set up a MySQL or MariaDB database server
Obtain the source code from the repository
Follow the detailed installation instructions at the address referenced in the README (URL not given in the text provided)
notable: Developed by the Greek Academic Network (GUnet) eLearning group
In use since March 2003, used by most Greek academic institutions according to the Greek README text
Mature, long-running open source LMS project
Available in Greek and English README text
caveats: Version 4.5 is stated as under development
Requires PHP 8.2 or newer and a MySQL or MariaDB database
Detailed installation guides are external and not included in the README text
